stories.title: CPSC Recall — Taleco Gear Baby Jumpers and Swings (52 Incidents, 32 Injuries)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: RECALL: Taleco Gear Baby Jumpers and Swings recalled Aug 13 — 52 incidents, 32 injuries. Fall and strangulation hazards. Sold on Amazon, Walmart, TalecoGear.com ($65-$120) from April 2021-July 2026. Stop use immediately. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: If you have a Taleco Gear baby jumper or swing at home, the CPSC says stop using it now. Fall and strangulation hazards — 32 kids were injured before this recall happened. Check CPSC.gov for full details. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: AAP Screen Time Guidelines — What Parents Need to Know

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: AAP's updated screen time guidance: no screens before 18 months. Up to 1 hour/day for ages 2-5 — but quality matters more than the clock. With school back in session, it's a good time to reset the family's screen habits. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
